description: printed to stderr (not stdout) when a command fails; the process exits with exit_code. Argument errors clap catches (an unknown flag, a missing value) print clap's usage text instead, exit 2

exit_code.description: 1 generic, 2 arguments/config, 3 auth, 4 PCE error, 5 rate limited (or GitHub unreachable: update check), 6 write refused, 7 blocked since an enforcement or by the draft once provisioned (policy impact --fail-on-blocked), 8 exposed, 9 snapshots differ, 10 a newer release (update check --fail-if-outdated)
